game_text: Deploy on table. Floating Refinery is suspended during opponent’s turn. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Floating Refinery, a non-unique cloud sector, or an Obsidian squadron TIE. During your turn, if you control 2 cloud sectors with TIEs, opponent loses 1 Force. {alter}

Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Margin credits one line each: left 'Original concept by Tyler Vastag', right 'Bespin Regionals 2006'. Lore corrected from scan: curly double quotes and curly apostrophe (wiki straight single quotes). Copyright '© 2001 …' (Tatooine) read off the scan. Base scan 350 px only.
